figures.caption: FIG. 5: Kerr-rotation (a) and Kerr-ellipticity (b) of GdIG after a similar optical excitation. Both measurements were performed with a pump wavelength of 267 nm and a pump power of 8 mW.

FIG. 2: Hysteresis measurements of both GdIG sublattices (a). The iron sublattice was measured with a 800 nm probe wavelength (red), the gadolinium sublattice was measured with a 400 nm probe wavelength (blue).
FIG. 4: Magnetic sublattices of GdIG above (left) and below (right) the compensation temperature. For both pictures the external magnetic field is pointing upwards.

FIG. 3: Normalized total time-resolved magnetization of the two sublattices of GdIG for (a) 4f-4f resonant excitation and (b) off resonant excitation. The crosses represent the measured data points, while the solid lines correspond to double exponential fits.
